title: Two members joke around; nobody addressed the bot

beats.speaker: mika
beats.beat: complain that you slept through your alarm again

beats.speaker: salt
beats.beat: make fun of them for it

beats.speaker: mika
beats.beat: come back with a dry retort

notes:
Proactivity restraint. Chiming into a human back-and-forth is the single most annoying thing a server bot does; this case is the gate on it. The 70s wait covers two proactive scan cycles (SCAN_SECONDS=25).

The proactivity block is load-bearing and was added after this scenario was found to be passing vacuously: the feature ships disabled, so for its first several runs Olisar was not declining to chime in, it was incapable of it. Level is set high and the cooldowns to zero deliberately — restraint under the most eager setting is the interesting question, and a pass at the default 'low' would prove much less.
